subject: I built this at 3AM
preview_text: A surprise feature I wasn't planning to share. It might change how you hear everything.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday, after a brutal commute where I couldn't hear a word of my podcast over the train noise, I stayed up late and built something on a whim. It wasn't on the roadmap. I wasn't planning to release it. But it worked so well on my own phone that I decided to slip it into the app for you.

It's a mode called 'Clear Voice' — a one-tap boost that filters out road rumble and brings dialogue and narration right to the front. No distortion. No harshness. Just the words, loud and clear. I've been using it on my drive to work, and it's like someone turned down the noise without turning down the story.

You'll find it in the EQ profiles section, right next to the one-tap Optimize. Tap 'Podcast' mode, then hit 'Clear Voice' — it auto-tunes your audio in real time. Works with any app: Audible, Spotify, YouTube, even phone calls. And it's completely free for now, because you were here before I planned to share it.
Open Loud EQ and try 'Clear Voice' on your next commute. I think you'll hear the difference immediately. P.S. It also works with your AirPods or wired headphones — just plug in and tap.
